name: compliguard
description: AI-powered GRC compliance platform. Manage frameworks, controls, findings, tasks and evidence through natural language.
author: CompliGuard

scopes.mcp:read: Read-only access to controls, findings, tasks

tools.name: list_frameworks
tools.description: List all active compliance frameworks for the organization. Optionally include control counts and compliance percentage.

includeControls.description: If true, include control counts and compliance percentage for each framework

tools.name: get_control_status
tools.description: Get full control details: title, description, status, assignees, evidence count, and linked findings.

controlId.description: The UUID of the control to retrieve

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: List security and compliance findings with optional severity and status filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of findings to return (default: 20)

tools.name: create_finding
tools.description: Create a new security or compliance finding. Returns the created finding ID.

affectedAsset.description: The asset or system affected by this finding

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List compliance tasks with optional status filter and assignment filter.

status.description: Filter by task status (todo, in_progress, done, blocked, overdue)

assignedToMe.description: If true, only return tasks assigned to the current user

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default: 20)

taskId.description: The UUID of the task to update

tools.name: get_compliance_score
tools.description: Get overall or per-framework compliance score (percentage of controls implemented or tested).

frameworkId.description: Optional UUID of a specific framework. If omitted, returns the overall score.

tools.name: search_controls
tools.description: Full-text search controls by title or description.

query.description: Search query string to match against control titles and descriptions

frameworkId.description: Optional UUID to restrict search to a specific framework

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List evidence items with optional control and status filters.

controlId.description: Optional UUID of a control to filter evidence by

status.description: Filter by evidence status (pending, approved, rejected, expired)

limit.description: Maximum number of evidence items to return (default: 20)

tools.name: get_risk_summary
tools.description: Get a risk summary: finding counts by severity, overdue tasks, frameworks below 70% compliance, and top 3 risk areas.

examples.prompt: What is our current SOC 2 compliance score?
Search for access control requirements in NIST

steps: Create an MCP API key with the required scopes
Register this skill in OpenClaw with your deployment URL and API key
